android.desc:
"Turn your phone into a minimalist phone launcher. Use screen time control, app blocker, and time limits to stay focused and increase productivity Reduce distractions, filter notifications and build healthier digital habits with a minimalist home screen designed for digital detox and less screen time.

What is minimalist phone?

minimalist phone is a minimalist launcher with app blocker and dumb phone interface designed to support productivity. Use minimalist phone as a focus launcher that helps you stay focused and build healthier phone habits.

FAQ

• What plans does the minimalist phone offer? You can choose from monthly, annual, or one-time purchase. All 3 plans include a free trial. • How to uninstall the minimalist phone? To go back to your original home screen uninstall the simple phone app by clicking on ""Uninstall"" here in the Play Store.

Features

👍 Icon-free home screen setup to support focus and reduce mindless scrolling 👍 App blocker – block apps and limit phone usage 👍 Block opening short videos – Block short videos on Youtube, Facebook, Instagram and Snapchat 👍 Blocking schedules – plan your daily screen time routine. Block distracting apps, and set limits for work, study, sleep, or use schedules as pomodoro timer for focus sessions 👍 Set in-app reminders and track your time with the progress bar 👍 Notification filter – hide unimportant notifications to reduce distractions and avoid procrastination 👍 Customizable themes, app renaming, and fonts, unlike opal, to reduce visual stimulation 👍 Supports work profile apps (install minimalist from non-work profile first) 👍 Grayscale / monochrome mode to reduce dopamine triggers

How does minimalist phone reduce screen time?

Open only the apps you need and spend less screen time on distractions. Plan your daily phone routine with blocking schedules that support focus, work, study & sleep. This dumb phone launcher combines app blocker, screen time control and grayscale to support digital detox and improve focus.

Use your phone in a mindful way to improve happiness, productivity and stay focused.

Take control of your habits and limit phone usage and reduce screen time on your device. The minimalist phone launcher is more than just an app theme with widgets - with app blocker & app hiding featues to restrict addictive apps.

quotes.text: I use https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.qqlabs.minimalistlauncher which has several things that pester you when opening certain applications. It also makes the home screen quite dull. Combine this with a monochrome display and the phone considerably loosens its grip on you.

quotes.text:
There are compromise solutions that make it a pain to use which goes a long way to defeating addiction. Here are a few

1. Make the screen monochrome. It greatly reduces the appeal of the entire system.

2. Increase the font size so that things don't look as pretty and slick. You deliberately cripple the UX.

3. As much as possible, use a browser instead of an "app" (e.g. X, Amazon etc.) and then set a limit for the time you can use your browser per day.

4. I use this as a launcher on my phone https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.qqlabs.minimalistlauncher which prevents has "mindfulness delays" for selected apps and other features that make the usage less smooth.

A combination of these has helped me reduce my attachment to the phone. There are also lots of times when I don't take it with me.

quotes.text:
I like my Pixel 5a but I don't want to see all the colored icons of the apps I have. I only want to see their names.

I'm now using the minimalist phone app [0]. It lets me favorite 3 apps (have 3 apps on my home screen), but there is a lot of wasted space. After the 3 apps are chosen, all others have to be searched for in the alphabetical list. But I want fast access to around 7 apps.

Is there a better solution than this? For someone looking for an optimized and minimalist smartphone experience
